item.title: Coralogix and Skyflow partner for privacy-focused observability in AI era
item.description: Coralogix and Skyflow formed a partnership to provide organisations with privacy-focused observability solutions for managing customer data.

item.title: Pondurance launches AI-powered SOC Kanati
item.description: Pondurance has announced the general availability of Kanati, its new Agentic AI designed to autonomously run security operations.

item.title: AWS Bahrain cloud services face disruption due to drone incident
item.description: AWS experienced a disruption in its Bahrain cloud region on Monday following reports of drone activity tied to ongoing Middle East conflict.

item.title: Broadcom launches Symantec CBX for under-resourced SOC teams
item.description: Broadcom has announced the launch of Symantec CBX, a cloud-based security platform that merges technologies from Symantec and Carbon Black.

item.title: Oracle launches agentic AI tools for enterprise data management
item.description: Oracle has introduced a series of agentic AI advancements to its AI Database platform to support organisations in developing AI applications.

item.title: Industry tracker GSA notes 5G acceleration – and caution – in private wireless market
item.description: The GSA’s Q4 2025 snapshot on private 4G/5G suggests it is a market that remains relevant only to certain enterprise segments.

item.title: GlobalFoundries sues Tower Semiconductor for US patent infringement
item.description: GlobalFoundries (GF) has commenced a series of patent infringement lawsuits against Israeli chip manufacturer Tower Semiconductor in the US.

item.title: Stelia and Nokia partner on enterprise-scale AI deployment
item.description: Stelia AI and Nokia have entered into a collaboration aimed at deploying AI solutions at an enterprise scale.

item.title: Nebius launches AI Cloud 3.5 with serverless AI compute
item.description: Nebius has released version 3.5 of its AI Cloud platform, adding serverless AI computing to simplify operations for developers.

item.title: AT&T launches new app: a comprehensive solution for home and mobile services
item.description: AT&T designed its new branded app to converge in-app management of wireless and home internet services, giving customers one place to manage their home network and devices, shop, and pay their bill.

item.title: Canadian quantum firm Xanadu debuts on public markets after SPAC deal
item.description: Xanadu Quantum Technologies, a Canadian company focused on photonic quantum computing, began trading on both the Nasdaq and TSX.

item.title: SAP to acquire Reltio to boost master data management for AI
item.description: Germany-based software company SAP has reached an agreement to acquire Reltio, a master data management software firm.

item.title: Tencent Cloud partners with ComfyUI to offer advanced 3D workflows in AI
item.description: Tencent Cloud, and ComfyUI have formed a partnership to integrate Tencent HY 3D Global into ComfyUI’s open-source visual AI platform.

item.title: Scamnetic and VanishID partner on enterprise scam prevention
item.description: The partnership merges Scamnetic’s scam detection with VanishID’s identity risk reduction to help organisations prevent losses.

item.title: Rebellions raises $400m pre-IPO funding for US expansion
item.description: Rebellions has secured $400m in a pre-IPO funding round, led by Mirae Asset Financial Group and the Korea National Growth Fund.
